text:
morgan: Quick sync thread. While landing a few 429/timeouts edits I ran into 5 broken external links and one missing include that blocked CI. PR is #1904. Thinking we need a small process + automation to avoid repeated churn.

tara: ugh, agreed. what's the lightweight plan? we don't need a whole pipeline for this.

morgan: proposal: 1) add a pre-merge linter check to validate external links respond (follow redirects) and warn if link host hasn't been updated in >1 year; 2) add an include-exists check for internal snippet includes; 3) nightly linkcheck job that files issues for pages with >2 broken links.

linh: for (2) I can add a rule to scan for `{{< include \"...\" >}}` paths and verify the file exists in the repo. I already found the moved SDK snippet `sdk/handlers/retry-429.md` and can update the include in #1904.

samir: small opt-out needed. We link vendor docs often. Suggest an inline comment like `<!-- linkcheck:ignore -->` to opt out per-link with maintainer signoff, and a whitelist for vendor domains with a 6-month grace period. I'll draft the whitelist config.

devex: style notes for snippet swaps: keep the top-level pseudo-code example intact and move language-specific blocks under collapsible headings. Also include a brief `Retry-After` header example for 429s.

docs-bot: logged proposal https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1905 (linkcheck automation + include validation).

morgan: I'll push the tiny fixes to #1904 (replace two external links with /playbooks/rate-limits/overview.md and archive snapshot; fix include). Then we can prototype the linter rule in a follow-up PR.

tara: I'll pick up wiring the GitHub Action that runs `linkinator` on built site artifacts nightly and optionally on PR. Ops suggested giving the action a service account so it can file issues.

samir: drafting the opt-out syntax and the whitelist heuristic in #1905. recommending 6 months for vendor domains and explicit `<!-- keep-external -->` comment for longer-lived exceptions.

linh: one more: ensure snippet harness `snippets/test-runner` runs after include changes. I will add that to the linter flow so include mismatches fail fast.

morgan: sweet. once CI is green for #1904 we merge, then follow ups: #1905 automation, #1906 PR-template add \"external links verified or opt-out included\" checklist item.

devex: thanks team. small wins: faster merges and less surprise lint failures.

morgan: merging #1904 once green. will follow up on the automation items.

tara: thanks all :thumbsup:
